verdict.rationale: Qodo applies actions across many items through automation and scoping rather than explicit user-driven bulk operations. It reviews every PR in connected repos automatically, organization-level settings and .pr_agent.toml config cascade to all repositories, and governance standards are enforced across every repository at scale. missing for 10: explicit bulk actions (e.g., resolving or dismissing many findings at once, or batch-triggering reviews across many PRs), a documented bulk API (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
